title: The EGM96 geoid on a 15-minute grid: the height of the geoid above the WGS 84 ellipsoid
provider: US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) and NASA (EGM96); the grid as GeographicLib distributes it (C. F. F. Karney)
format: A bzip2 tar archive holding geoids/egm96-15.pgm: a binary PGM (P5) of 1440 x 721 big-endian 16-bit values, point-registered at 15 arc-minutes from 90 N and 0 E; the undulation N = -108 + 0.003 x value metres (its comments' Offset and Scale). data/products/geoid_grid.py extracts it to data/cache/products/geoid/egm96-15.pgm. Bilinear interpolation errs by 4 cm RMS and 1.2 m at most, cubic by 0.7 cm and 17 cm (GeographicLib's statement in the file).
licence: EGM96 is a US Government work in the public domain; GeographicLib distributes its geoid files with the library, under the MIT licence.
citation: Lemoine, F. G., et al. (1998), The Development of the Joint NASA GSFC and the National Imagery and Mapping Agency (NIMA) Geopotential Model EGM96, NASA/TP-1998-206861; Karney, C. F. F., GeographicLib, https://geographiclib.sourceforge.io/C++/doc/geoid.html.
